constraints: Preserve the existing page design, component order, grids, typography, colours, spacing, image ratios and responsive behaviour.
Logical copy IDs are not existing CSS selectors or CMS field names.
Bind each item to the intended campaign-page instance before modifying it. If anchors mismatch or the page is different, stop automatic application and produce a mapping report.
Do not modify the shared AI Assistant product page, shared navigation, footer or global /demo/ page solely because they are the reviewed fallback sources.
Replace only approved text nodes or CMS fields. Never perform a global replacement of the words AI Assistant, demo or Get started.
Preserve form input names, values, IDs, required flags, submission endpoint, CRM mapping, consent wording, privacy links and analytics identifiers.
Belgian Dutch display labels must not change underlying geographic option values. Do not rename an EU value to a Belgian regional institution.
Optional existing-slot copy must be omitted if no matching slot exists. Do not add sections or fields automatically.
Monitoring activation must not be claimed on the form-submit state. Only a real booking may trigger T05.
Do not add free, 30 days, no credit card, unlimited access, all institutions, response-time or savings claims without campaign-specific confirmation.
Keep both desktop and mobile instances consistent. Review line wrapping without reducing type size or redesigning components.
No customer quote, logo, endorsement or user account data may be invented.

copy.en: Your topic. Your monitor. Set up for you.

copy.en: Tell us the policy topic you follow. We’ll prepare your Polpo trial with searches and email alerts tailored to it. After a 30-minute training session and account handover, your monitoring starts.

copy.en: Begin with your own policy topic. We prepare the searches and alert settings, then review them with you in your trial account. You can explore the available political information and see how the setup fits your day-to-day work.
copy.nl-BE: Start met het dossier waar je nu aan werkt. Wij bereiden de zoekopdrachten en meldingen voor en nemen ze samen met je door in je proefaccount. Zo verken je de beschikbare politieke informatie en zie je hoe de monitor aansluit op jouw werk.

copy.en: In 30 minutes, we review your setup, show you the controls and hand over access. Your monitoring starts straight afterwards.

copy.en: Adjust your saved searches and alert preferences as your priorities change. You remain in control of what you follow.
copy.nl-BE: Pas je opgeslagen zoekopdrachten en meldingen aan wanneer je prioriteiten veranderen. Jij bepaalt wat je opvolgt.

copy.en: Your monitor, ready in two steps

copy.en: 1. Tell us what you follow

copy.en: Complete the form with your policy topic and relevant institutions. We use your answers to prepare your trial account and tailored alerts.
copy.nl-BE: Vul het formulier in met je beleidsdossier en de relevante instellingen. Met jouw antwoorden bereiden we je proefaccount en e-mailmeldingen voor.

copy.en: 2. Get your 30-minute training and account handover

copy.en: We walk you through your prepared account, refine the setup together and hand it over to you. Your monitoring starts immediately after the session.
copy.nl-BE: We tonen je het voorbereide account, verfijnen samen de inrichting en geven je toegang. Meteen na de sessie start je monitoring.

copy.en: Let’s set up your first monitor
copy.nl-BE: Laat je eerste monitor voor je instellen

copy.en: Share your topic. We’ll prepare the setup and show you how to use it in your 30-minute training.
copy.nl-BE: Deel je Belgische dossier. Wij bereiden de inrichting voor en tonen je tijdens een training van 30 minuten hoe je ermee werkt.

copy.en: What will I receive?
copy.nl-BE: Wat krijg ik?

copy.implementation_note: Reuse an existing FAQ slot. If no slot exists in the approved campaign page, do not create a new section automatically.

copy.en: A Polpo trial account with saved searches and email alerts configured around your topic. We review the setup with you and hand over access during the 30-minute training.
copy.nl-BE: Een Polpo-proefaccount met opgeslagen zoekopdrachten en e-mailmeldingen rond jouw dossier. Tijdens de training van 30 minuten nemen we de inrichting door en geven we je toegang.

copy.en: What happens after I complete the form?
copy.nl-BE: Wat gebeurt er nadat ik het formulier invul?

copy.implementation_note: Reuse an existing FAQ slot. If no slot exists in the approved campaign page, do not create a new section automatically.

copy.en: We use your answers to prepare your account and arrange the training with you. Submitting the form requests your trial; monitoring starts after the training and account handover.
copy.nl-BE: We gebruiken je antwoorden om je account voor te bereiden en de training met je in te plannen. Met het formulier vraag je een proefaccount aan; je monitoring start na de training en overdracht.

copy.en: Why is the training included?
copy.nl-BE: Waarom hoort er een training bij?

copy.implementation_note: Reuse an existing FAQ slot. If no slot exists in the approved campaign page, do not create a new section automatically.

copy.en: The session is held in your own prepared account. We check your topic and alert settings, show you how to use and adjust the monitor, and give you access to continue independently.
copy.nl-BE: De sessie vindt plaats in jouw voorbereide account. We controleren je dossier en meldingen, tonen hoe je de monitor gebruikt en aanpast, en geven je toegang om zelf verder te werken.

copy.en: When will I receive updates?
copy.nl-BE: Wanneer ontvang ik updates?

copy.implementation_note: Reuse an existing FAQ slot. If no slot exists in the approved campaign page, do not create a new section automatically.

copy.en: Monitoring starts immediately after handover. An email alert is sent when matching information is available, according to your alert settings. The first new alert therefore depends on relevant publications and your chosen frequency.
copy.nl-BE: Je monitoring start meteen na de overdracht. Je ontvangt e-mailmeldingen zodra passende informatie beschikbaar is, volgens je instellingen. De eerste nieuwe melding hangt dus af van relevante publicaties en de gekozen frequentie.

copy.en: Can I change my topic or alerts?
copy.nl-BE: Kan ik mijn dossier of meldingen aanpassen?

copy.implementation_note: Reuse an existing FAQ slot. If no slot exists in the approved campaign page, do not create a new section automatically.

copy.en: Yes. You can adjust your saved searches and alert preferences yourself. We show you how during the training.
copy.nl-BE: Ja. Je kunt je opgeslagen zoekopdrachten en meldingen zelf aanpassen. Tijdens de training tonen we hoe dat werkt.

copy.en: Which political sources are included?

copy.en: We agree the relevant institutions and available sources for your topic when preparing the account. You can see the selected sources in your trial.
copy.nl-BE: Bij de voorbereiding stemmen we af welke beschikbare Belgische bronnen relevant zijn voor jouw dossier. Je ziet de geselecteerde bronnen in je proefaccount.

copy.en: One topic is enough to get started. We’ll use your answers to prepare your trial, then arrange your 30-minute training and account handover.
